text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no command-execution tool, so the suite hasn't been run. I checked each fix by reading it against the tests.

- **`fees.py`:** the late fee now multiplies `days_late` by the daily rate instead of adding it.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5. It was 3, which didn't match the five-book policy or the tests.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` now includes `Emma` by Austen (1815, 1 copy), so it returns all three titles.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. It was importing from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
